Each runner that uses it (its docstring lists them: 16 subprocess --witnesses runners, 4 subprocess --generated-mutants sweeps, the in-process sweeps of codex_adapter, gemini_adapter and labelling, the in-process --witnesses of codex_agents_off, codex_patch_reads, codex_started_file_change, codex_usage_source, native_snapshot, review_kit and vendor_bookkeeping, and test_endstate's control) runs its selection with no mutant first and refuses with exit 3 (BaselineRed, a SystemExit, and one BASELINE RED line) before running or counting any mutant when that run is red or a check raises. Exempt, each already controlled by its own code and exiting 1 before any mutant: test_walk_plan --generated-mutants, test_gemini_tool_registry and test_gemini_undeclared_args --witnesses, and the TestWitnesses classes of codex_adapter, gemini_adapter and labelling; test_pf1_freeze_gates' TestWitnesses runs in-suite only, beside each clause's own green test. Residual (round-1 review finding 6): a witness baseline runs its bound methods' union in one process while each mutant runs one method alone, so an order- or state-dependent red is not caught, and one baseline run cannot catch a flaky test.
